The chief necromancers of the {wiki:Brotherhood of Bones|Brotherhood of Bones} guard a valuable treasure deep in {wiki:Drefia|Drefia}, west of Darashia. Cross the main dungeon full of undead, pass the level 60 gate and open the coffin holding the {item:Medusa Shield}, the {item:Blue Robe} and the {item:Skull Staff}.
The head necromancers of the Brotherhood of Bones guard a valuable treasure here.
Minimum level 60 to pass the {item:Gate of Expertise} (recommended 70).
to open the hole on the 3rd floor
Daily respawns on the sacrifice stones, if nobody has taken them: 1 {item:White Pearl}, 1 {item:Black Pearl}, 1 {item:Small Ruby}, 1 {item:Small Emerald}
Use the {spell:Invisible} spell in the Drefia dungeon: the amount of undead is huge.

At lower levels, bring a mage or paladin who goes invisible and uses {spell:Great Fireball} several times to clear most of the spawn; then quickly kill the {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}.
The maps below may be outdated since the Drefia remodelling: if in doubt, follow the written directions.
1. Going down to the 3rd floor of the main dungeon

First go to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your city's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia} and {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}). {wiki:Drefia|Drefia} is **west** of Darashia ({coord:33018,32443,7}), on the other side of the mountains that separate Ankrahmun, Darashia, Drefia and Tiquanda. There are several routes: for example, use the {item:Rope} to climb the mountain here {coord:33048,32429,7}, or come through the passage between Darashia and Ankrahmun.
Rope spot to climb up to Drefia
There are lots of {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} on the mountain: keep some mana to cure the poison with {spell:Cure Poison} (or bring {item:Antidote|Antidotes}).
Go to {wiki:Drefia|Drefia}, west of Darashia, and enter the main dungeon. Cast {spell:Invisible} before you enter.
Follow the green lines on the map, or simply go down to the **third floor** of the main dungeon.
Follow the green lines to the 3rd floor of the main dungeon
On the 3rd floor, walk **north** about 18 steps. On your **left** there is a hole: open it with the {item:Shovel} and go down.
2. Passing the gate and reaching the treasure room
Follow the map, or go **east** and pass through the level 60 {item:Gate of Expertise}.
Follow the green lines through the level 60 gates

Get ready: after the gate there is an undead army ({creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, {creature:Zombie|Zombies}, {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, several {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, several {creature:Priestess|Priestesses} and their summons: {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Ghost|Ghosts} and {creature:Mummy|Mummies}). With luck, the room will already be cleared.
The rare {creature:Necropharus} may appear. Beyond the quest room is the {wiki:Drefia Wyrm Lair|Drefia Wyrm Lair}, a popular hunting place.
The {item:Medusa Shield}, the {item:Blue Robe} and the {item:Skull Staff} are in a coffin in the **east** section of the room.

On the sacrifice stones in the room there are {wiki:Daily Respawns|daily respawns} that you can take if nobody else has done so: 1 {item:White Pearl}, 1 {item:Black Pearl}, 1 {item:Small Ruby} and 1 {item:Small Emerald}.

There is no shortcut out: go back the same way. Pass the {item:Gate of Expertise} again, return to the hole you opened with the {item:Shovel} and use the {item:Rope} to climb up to the 3rd floor. Then go up the floors of the main dungeon to the entrance ({coord:32996,32413,7}) and cross the mountain back to **Darashia**.
The undead respawn: keep {spell:Invisible} active on the way back.
